items.title: 云层透光对比与密度 · 实时调节
items.requirements: Review live contrast from 0 to 80 percent attenuation and independent cloud density sliders, their visible effect, numerical feedback, reset and local settings persistence, keyboard/mouse input and panel fit at 1920x1080 and 1280x720. Default attenuation remains thin 10 percent / thick 30 percent; verify the user-requested 80 percent maximum and dynamic native sunlight retaining a 20 percent floor. Earlier r3 radiometry and physical-route evidence is historical, not represented as rerun by this focused revision. Original artwork, camera and character proportions remain unchanged. Technical checks do not grant aesthetic approval.
